record.body: Retain every one of the 279 laboratory candidates from the supplied frozen Edition 1.3 lab package: 165 glossary, 49 formula, 28 crosswalk, 37 unresolved questions. Retain 16 proposed experimental programs and all 21 explicit mathematical bridge identifiers, with category-specific claim ceilings. 8 finite mathematical checks reproduced in the lab are offline examples, not empirical LLM/provider or Golden Egg observations. The complete ID-preserving ledger is in /encyclopedia/research/2026-10-23-proposal-and-rest-addendum.json. Source ownership for externally published SignalRupture material is retained. Canonical Research Edition 1.4 contains 843 records and already correctly defines AIA G-144 as Anisotropic Information Architecture. This source note records catalog comparison and dispositions without promoting any of the untested proposals.
